subject: Pilot wrap-up + Q4 uplift?
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@blueharbor.ai>
Date: 2027-10-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot wrap-up + Q4 uplift?

Hi Samir —

Great working with you these last six weeks. Usage looks healthy and the team has flagged a few high-value flows that would map well to your product roadmap. I know you mentioned an internal Q4 push to finalize vendor decisions this week. If it helps speed evaluation and get Procurement comfortable, we can offer a one-time conversion package: a 30-day trial extension + $6,000 in platform credits applied upon signature.

If you want that, I can send a short amendment for signature and a DocuSign link for your procurement team. Does that sound helpful? If so, please confirm the procurement contact and preferred billing entity (I saw both Blue Harbor Labs and Blue Harbor Inc in the purchase docs).

Thanks —
Alex Martinez
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: pilot_usage_summary.csv (usage snapshot)

From: Samir Patel <samir@blueharbor.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-10-20T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot wrap-up + Q4 uplift?

Alex —

Appreciate the outreach. The team is definitely interested in moving faster, and procurement is asking for the offer in writing (line items and timeline). Procurement will want the amendment routed to procurement@blueharbor.ai. 

Quick questions: 1) Does the $6,000 credit require a minimum committed spend? 2) Can the extension start immediately when the DocuSign is completed, or does it have to align with our pilot end date?

If you can send the amendment to procurement@blueharbor.ai and cc me I’ll get it routed.

—Samir
Head of AI Initiatives | Blue Harbor Labs
samir@blueharbor.ai

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>

Cc: 
Date: 2027-10-20T13:10:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Pilot wrap-up + Q4 uplift? — approval request

Ben / Marissa —

Looping you in on Blue Harbor: Samir asked for a written offer to get procurement moving. Deal summary below:
- Account: Blue Harbor Labs; HubSpot deal RDW-2027-4521
- ARR potential: $120k first year (forecast)
- Current pilot ARR-equivalent usage: low-to-mid $k/month
- Ask: 30-day trial extension + $6,000 one-time platform credit applied after signature
- Procurement contact: procurement@blueharbor.ai
- Reason: Q4 close window, strong product fit, high chance of conversion if procurement signs quickly.

Approvals I need: one-time credit above rep-level threshold and confirmation on whether this needs legal/CFO signoff. I attached the pilot usage snapshot and a short term sheet draft (q4_credit_term_sheet.pdf).

If approved, I’ll send the amendment and DocuSign link to procurement and cc Samir.

Thanks —
Alex

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-10-20T15:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot wrap-up + Q4 uplift? — approval request

Alex —

Thanks for the summary. Approve the concept — we want to be aggressive in the last week of Q4. A few constraints:
- My standard authorization cap is $5k in one-time credits for AE-led deals. Above that needs written sign-off from Finance (Marissa) or Sales Ops.
- If Finance is reluctant to do $6k, propose $5k credit + two 4-hour onboarding sessions with our Solutions Engineers (value-add) — that often gets procurement to say yes without additional budget.
- Document: please include a clause that credits expire 90 days after issuance and are non-transferable.

If Marissa signs off on $6k, we proceed as Alex described.

—Ben

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-10-20T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot wrap-up + Q4 uplift? — approval request

Ben / Alex —

Okay to approve the full $6,000 one-time credit for Blue Harbor, given the ARR upside and timing (Q4 close push). Please note the following conditions:
1) Legal needs to approve the amendment language; route via legal-templates@redwood.ai (I will cc Legal when Alex sends the DocuSign).
2) Finance needs the HubSpot deal id (RDW-2027-4521) and the final invoice/billing entity to be recorded before credits are applied.
3) Credits must be tied to the first 90 days of post-signature consumption and will be applied as a billing credit; add an explicit expiration date in the amendment.

I’ll approve on the record — go ahead and send the amendment. I’ll confirm in HubSpot once it’s signed.

Marissa Cole
Senior Finance Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Hi Samir / Procurement team —

Per our conversation and internal approvals, Redwood is prepared to offer the following to help close Blue Harbor’s evaluation this week:

Offer summary:
- 30-day trial extension starting on the date of signature
- One-time platform credit: $6,000 to be applied as a billing credit within 90 days of signature
- Credits apply to usage and are non-transferable; unused credits expire 90 days after issuance
- No additional minimum committed spend required; credits contingent on execution of the one-page amendment (attached)

Next steps:
1) Procurement: please review the attached term sheet (q4_credit_term_sheet.pdf) and sign the amendment via the DocuSign link below.
2) Once signed, we will apply credits and extend the trial immediately.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/sign/abcdef123456
HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.company/contacts/deal/RDW-2027-4521

If procurement prefers, we can instead offer $5,000 credit + two SE onboarding sessions — let me know which is preferable.

Thanks for pushing this across the finish line — I’ll monitor the DocuSign and confirm once everything is fully executed.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.ai
